metadata.title: 雙十連假離島管制航線將於下週一開放訂位

a-20260726-1748-caa-taiwan-announces-1-3.text: 雙十連假離島管制航線將於下週一開放訂位 台灣交通部民用航空局宣布,2026年雙十節3天連假期間,澎湖、金門及馬祖三離島管制航線將提供1,102架次、共計89,926個座位數。相關機票將於8月10日上午9時起統一開放訂位。本次航空疏運期自10月8日至10月12日,為期5天,尖峰時段管制航線機票將加註使用限制。 台灣交通部民用航空局於8月7日宣布,2026年雙十節連假澎湖、金門及馬祖三離島管制航線將於8月10日上午9時起開放訂位。本次雙十節共有3天連假,自10月9日至10月11日,民航局規劃10月8日至10月12日為5天的航空疏運期,呼籲有需求旅客儘早規劃。 民航局指出,本次疏運期間三離島航線共提供1,102架次、計89,926個座位。其中澎湖航線提供498架次、36,828個座位;金門航線提供470架次、44,018個座位;馬祖航線則提供134架次、9,080個座位。為確保運能效率,尖峰時段機票均會加註「限當日當班次」等使用限制。 Taiwan to Open Bookings for Double Tenth Holiday Flights to Offshore Islands on August 10 Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that bookings for flights to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu during the 2026 Double Tenth Day holiday will open on August 10 at 9:00 AM. metadata.title: 倫敦蓋特威克機場夏季高峰停水 旅客設施受影響

a-20260727-0708-gatwick-airport-experien.text: 倫敦蓋特威克機場夏季高峰停水 旅客設施受影響 根據 Simple Flying 與 BBC 的報導,倫敦蓋特威克機場於2026年7月26日(星期日)遭遇全園區自來水中斷,導致旅客廁所、餐飲及清潔服務無法正常運作。機場人員已派發瓶裝水、臨時廁所並啟動修復工程,盡快恢復供水。 根據 Simple Flying 的報導,倫敦蓋特威克機場的旅客在2026年7月26日星期日遇到『乾燥的一天』,因為終端大樓的服務因自來水中斷而停止。 BBC 的報導指出,蓋特威克機場亦遭遇『running water outage』,同樣是在夏季旅遊高峰期間發生。 水中斷導致旅客廁所、餐飲攤位及清潔服務無法正常使用,旅客只能依賴機場臨時提供的瓶裝水與簡易廁所。 機場方面已啟動應變措施,派發瓶裝水、設置臨時衛生設施,並與承包商協調搶修供水管線,盡快恢復正常供水。 Gatwick Airport Experiences Water Outage During Peak Summer Travel According to reports from Simple Flying and the BBC, London Gatwick Airport suffered a complete loss of running water on Sunday, July 26, 2026, during the peak of the summer holiday season. The outage affected terminal restrooms, food outlets and cleaning services, leaving passengers without basic amenities. Airport officials said they have deployed bottled water distribution and are working with contractors to restore the water supply as quickly as possible. Simple Flying reported that Gatwick's customers had a 'dry Sunday' as terminal services shut down due to a loss of running water. The BBC also reported that Gatwick Airport was hit by a running water outage, occurring during the busy summer holiday period. The water shortage prevented passengers from using restrooms, food outlets and cleaning services, forcing the airport to provide bottled water and temporary facilities. Airport officials activated contingency plans, distributing bottled water, setting up temporary toilets, and working with contractors to repair the water supply system as swiftly as possible. a-20260728-0319-boeing-787-9-leads-2026-.text: 波音787-9居2026年廣體機交付首位 加速三款舊機型退役 根據報導,波音787-9於2026年成為全球交付量最高的廣體客機。隨著波音787-9機型持續引進與交付,該機型的到來正進一步加速四家航空公司旗下共三款舊型客機的退役歷程。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,波音 787-9 機型在 2026 年的廣體客機交付數量中位居首位,成為該年度全球交付量最多的廣體客機。此項交付統計反應出該款機型在當前民航市場中的交機規模。 隨著新一批波音 787-9 廣體客機陸續交付,該機型的到來正進一步加速機隊的更新換代。據報導,波音 787-9 的引進正加速四家航空公司旗下共計三款舊型客機的退役歷程。 此項機隊轉型影響涵蓋多家營運業者,透過引進波音 787-9 提升營運效率,並逐步淘汰較舊款式的客機機隊。 Boeing 787-9 Leads 2026 Widebody Deliveries, Accelerating Older Aircraft Retirements According to a report by Simple Flying, the Boeing 787-9 has emerged as the most-delivered widebody aircraft globally in 2026. The steady arrival and introduction of these new Boeing 787-9 aircraft are currently accelerating the retirement phase of three older legacy aircraft models across four commercial airlines. As new deliveries proceed throughout the year, these fleet adjustments reflect broader airline operational transitions and ongoing efforts by multiple international carriers to replace aging legacy twin-aisle equipment with modern widebody passenger jets. The Boeing 787-9 is leading widebody aircraft deliveries in 2026, positioning the model as the most-delivered twin-aisle passenger aircraft of the year, according to report details published by Simple Flying. The ongoing arrival of these newly delivered Boeing 787-9 twinjets is actively accelerating the retirement process of three legacy aircraft types. Across four commercial airlines, operators are replacing older passenger jets as these new widebody aircraft enter active airline service. The transition highlights current fleet planning adjustments within the commercial airline sector, where new long-haul aircraft deliveries directly support the phase-out of older legacy fleet types. metadata.title: 瑞航LX16因客艙煙霧改降班戈 208名乘客及機組員平安

a-20260728-0855-swiss-lx16-diverts-bango.text: 瑞航LX16因客艙煙霧改降班戈 208名乘客及機組員平安 瑞士國際航空LX16於美東時間7月27日12時14分左右,因商務艙出現來源不明煙霧,改降美國緬因州班戈國際機場。航機安全落地,消防檢查未發現火源或異常熱度;SWISS表示208名乘客及機組員均平安。FAA初步資料則記載機組員通報駕駛艙起火,兩種說法仍待調查釐清。 瑞士國際航空(SWISS)一架由蘇黎世飛往紐約甘迺迪國際機場的LX16航班,於美國東部夏令時間2026年7月27日約12時14分改降緬因州班戈國際機場。該時間換算為協調世界時7月27日16時14分、台灣時間7月28日0時14分。當地媒體引述航空公司說法指出,機組員因商務艙區域出現煙霧而決定改降;航機其後安全落地,緊急狀況解除。 Portland Press Herald引述SWISS發言人Michael Pelzer表示,航機在班戈安全降落,過程沒有再發生其他事件。當地消防人員落地後檢查航空器,未發現火源或異常熱度。航空公司表示,機上208名乘客及機組員均平安;班戈國際機場跑道因應緊急處置關閉約半小時,並於當地時間約12時30分重新開放。 事件初步描述仍有差異。SWISS對外表示,煙霧出現在商務艙最前方區域;美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)的初步事故聲明則記載,機組員曾通報駕駛艙起火。FAA同時註明相關資料屬初步訊息、可能變更。本文因此分別保留航空公司與監管機關的說法,不將「商務艙煙霧」與「駕駛艙起火」視為已獲確認的同一項結論。 SWISS目前尚未確定煙霧來源,並表示將對航空器進行完整檢查,在調查完成前不會推測可能原因。FAA亦表示將調查此事。現階段可確認的結果是LX16已在班戈安全落地、消防檢查未發現火源或異常熱度,且航空公司未通報人員受傷;煙霧的位置、性質與成因仍須等待後續檢查或主管機關更新。 SWISS LX16 Diverts to Bangor After Smoke; Passengers and Crew Safe SWISS flight LX16 diverted to Bangor International Airport at about 12:14 p.m. EDT on July 27 after smoke was reported in the business-class cabin. The Airbus A330 landed safely, and firefighters found no signs of fire or heat. SWISS said all 208 passengers and crew were safe. The FAA’s preliminary statement separately said the crew had reported a cockpit fire, a description that remains subject to change and differs from the airline’s account. SWISS International Air Lines flight LX16, operating from Zurich to New York John F. Kennedy International Airport, diverted to Bangor International Airport in Maine at about 12:14 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time on July 27, 2026. That corresponds to 16:14 UTC on July 27 and 12:14 a.m. in Taiwan on July 28. Local reporting, citing the airline, said the crew diverted after smoke was detected in the business-class section. The aircraft landed safely and the emergency was resolved. SWISS spokesperson Michael Pelzer told the Portland Press Herald that the aircraft landed in Bangor without further incident. Local firefighters inspected the aircraft after landing and found no signs of fire or heat. The airline said all 208 passengers and crew were safe. Bangor International Airport’s runway was closed for roughly half an hour during the response and reopened at around 12:30 p.m. local time. The initial descriptions of the event are not identical. SWISS said the unexplained smoke was in the forward part of the business-class cabin. The Federal Aviation Administration’s preliminary incident statement said the crew had reported a cockpit fire. The FAA states that its initial information is preliminary and subject to change. AVWIRE is therefore preserving the two attributed descriptions separately rather than treating either location or the presence of fire as a settled conclusion. SWISS said it had not determined what caused the smoke and would conduct a thorough inspection of the aircraft, adding that it would not speculate before that work was completed. The FAA also said it would investigate. The confirmed outcome at this stage is that LX16 landed safely at Bangor, firefighters detected no fire or heat during their inspection, and the airline reported no injuries. The location, nature and cause of the smoke remain subject to further examination and official updates. LX16於班戈當地時間7月27日12時14分安全落地。 has landed safely at 12:14 local. The emergency was resolved. metadata.title: 總統府啟動2026無人機競賽 排除紅色供應鏈產品

a-20260728-0902-taiwan-presidential-offi.text: 總統府啟動2026無人機競賽 排除紅色供應鏈產品 總統府於2026年7月28日宣布啟動「總統盃2026無人機競賽」,以民主同盟及非紅供應鏈為主題。活動由經濟部、教育部及國科會共同辦理各項賽事,並由國科會、工研院與中科院建立審查機制,凡涉及紅色供應鏈之器材或產品均不具參賽資格。 總統府於2026年7月28日召開新聞發布會,正式公布「總統盃2026無人機競賽」活動。總統府秘書長潘孟安表示,這次競賽以「民主同盟」及「非紅供應鏈」為主要主題,希望透過賽事培育科技應用人才。官方特別明確規範,凡涉及紅色供應鏈的器材或產品均不具備參賽資格,相關規則將載明於賽事規範中。 根據總統府說明,總統賴清德於2024年下半年指示希望透過無人機帶動國內產業發展,經跨部會整合與一年多籌備,參考美國 Green UAS(綠色無人機系統)標準,建構非紅無人機供應鏈。本次競賽由經濟部、國科會及教育部共同辦理,推動產、官、學、研共同參與。 在具體競賽項目方面,經濟部將辦理包括「無人機堆積木」、「無人機避障賽」以及「無人機精準投放」等障礙飛行挑戰賽。教育部則負責辦理「無人機足球競賽」,從小學階段開始推動無人機操作。國家科學及技術委員會則負責規劃辦理「關鍵技術挑戰賽」。 在賽事時程與地點安排上,經濟部主辦的競賽項目自2026年7月28日起開始受理報名,報名截止日期為8月31日,決賽預計於12月25在大台南會展中心舉辦。相關賽程與規範均已公布於各相關部會網站。 針對參賽設備的供應鏈檢核,國科會將聯合工業技術研究院及國家中山科學研究院共同建立檢核機制。經濟部產業發展署表示,非紅無人機審查流程分為三個階段,設備必須全面符合資格要求始准參賽。此外,活動現場亦規劃國防能量、應用服務、產業能量及學研成果等四項展示。 Taiwan Presidential Office Launches 2026 Drone Competition Excluding Red Supply Chain Taiwan's Presidential Office announced the launch of the Presidential Cup 2026 Drone Competition on July 28, 2026, focusing on the themes of democratic alliance and non-red supply chains. a-20260728-1208-boeing-reports-q2-revenu.text: 波音第二季營收246億美元 交付171架民航機 波音公布2026年第二季營收246億美元,GAAP每股虧損0.67美元,反映171架商業飛機交付量增加。737-7與737-10認證試飛已完成,預計2026年取得認證、2027年首次交付。777X獲FAA批准展開認證試飛,同樣預計2027年首次交付。 波音公司公布2026年第二季財報,營收達246億美元,GAAP每股虧損0.67美元,核心每股虧損(非GAAP)0.76美元。營運現金流14億美元,自由現金流(非GAAP)6億美元。執行長Kelly Ortberg表示營運更加穩定,關鍵認證計畫按進度進行。 第二季商業飛機部門營收118億美元,營業利潤率為負2.7%,主要反映較高交付量與有利組合。本季共交付171架飛機,並錄得246架淨訂單,包括來自大韓航空、達美航空及SMBC Capital的訂單。商業飛機積壓訂單超過6,200架,價值5,970億美元。 737計畫本季開始將產能過渡至每月47架,並於7月在737 North Line啟動低速初始生產。截至7月,737-7與737-10的認證試飛均已完成,公司持續預期兩款機型於2026年取得認證、2027年首次交付。 777X計畫本季獲得FAA批准,在Type Inspection Authorization 4B下展開認證試飛,公司持續預期2027年首次交付。國防、太空與安全部門第二季營收75億美元,營業利潤率為負0.2%,其中包含VC-25B計畫2.8億美元虧損,主要因額外生產與認證資源投入,首次交付預計2028年。 季末總公司積壓訂單增至7,150億美元的紀錄高點。現金及有價證券投資總計200億美元,較季初的209億美元減少,反映債務償付部分被本季產生的現金流抵消。公司維持100億美元信用額度,仍未動用。 Boeing Reports Q2 Revenue of $24.6 Billion, 171 Commercial Deliveries Boeing recorded second quarter revenue of $24.6 billion with a GAAP loss per share of $0.67, reflecting 171 commercial aircraft deliveries. metadata.title: FAA 7月28日空中交通展望 雷雨可能影響美國多地航班

a-20260728-1520-faa-us-weather-air-traff.text: FAA 7月28日空中交通展望 雷雨可能影響美國多地航班 FAA 7月28日空中交通報告指出,雷雨可能延誤夏洛特、丹佛、費城、佛州、紐約及華府航班;西雅圖與舊金山可能受低雲影響,拉斯維加斯則預期強風。FAA提醒報告僅供作業規劃,旅客仍應向航空公司查詢個別航班。 美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)7月28日發布每日空中交通報告,指出雷雨可能延誤夏洛特(CLT)、丹佛(DEN)、費城,以及佛羅里達州的DJT、勞德岱堡(FLL)、奧蘭多(MCO)與邁阿密(MIA)等機場航班。紐約地區的紐瓦克(EWR)、甘迺迪(JFK)、拉瓜地亞(LGA),以及華府地區的巴爾的摩/華盛頓(BWI)、雷根華盛頓(DCA)與華盛頓杜勒斯(IAD)也在報告列出的可能影響範圍內。 除了雷雨,FAA預估低雲可能拖慢西雅圖(SEA)與舊金山(SFO)的空中交通,拉斯維加斯(LAS)則預期出現強風。報告使用「可能延誤」與「可能拖慢」等措辭,並未表示所有列名機場都已發生延誤,也沒有宣告個別航班取消。實際流量措施仍會隨天氣預報、機場容量與其他FAA無法控制的因素改變。 FAA說明,每日空中交通報告提供正常空中交通可能受到影響的合理預期,涵蓋到離場延誤、地面停等或機場關閉等情況,主要供空中交通作業規劃使用。FAA另請旅客向承運航空公司查詢個別航班延誤資料;需要即時空中交通作業資訊者,可查看FAA提供的即時狀態網站。這表示每日報告應視為系統層級的規劃快照,而不是單一航班的最終狀態。 在較早的相關規劃方面,FAA於6月22日公布Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories(SMART)計畫。FAA表示,SMART將持續分析航空公司班表、天氣、機場容量、空域狀況與作業限制,在衝突發生前預測交通流量,協助FAA、航空公司與營運單位協調航路及到離場時間。 FAA當時表示,SMART初始作業預計於2026年秋季開始。這項6月公布的現代化計畫與7月28日每日展望屬不同資料:前者說明未來流量管理工具,後者記錄當日天氣可能造成的作業影響。FAA並未表示7月28日報告已由SMART產生。 FAA July 28 Outlook Flags Weather Delay Risks Across Multiple U.S. Hubs The FAA’s July 28 daily air traffic report said thunderstorms could delay flights in Charlotte, Denver, Philadelphia, Florida, New York and the Washington, D.C. area. Low clouds may slow Seattle and San Francisco traffic, while high winds are expected in Las Vegas. The FAA said the report is for operational planning and travelers should check flight-specific information with their airlines. The Federal Aviation Administration’s July 28 daily air traffic report said thunderstorms could delay flights in Charlotte (CLT), Denver (DEN), Philadelphia and several Florida airports, including DJT, Fort Lauderdale (FLL), Orlando (MCO) and Miami (MIA). The same outlook listed the New York-area airports Newark (EWR), John F. Kennedy (JFK) and LaGuardia (LGA), along with Baltimore/Washington (BWI), Ronald Reagan Washington National (DCA) and Washington Dulles (IAD) in the Washington, D.C. region. The FAA also said low clouds may slow traffic in Seattle (SEA) and San Francisco (SFO), while high winds are expected in Las Vegas (LAS). The wording describes possible operational effects rather than confirming that every listed airport is already experiencing a delay. It also does not announce cancellations for individual flights. Conditions and traffic-management measures may change with weather forecasts and other factors beyond the agency’s control. The agency said its daily report provides a reasonable expectation of impacts to normal air traffic operations, including arrival or departure delays, ground stops and airport closures. The information is intended for air traffic operations planning. The FAA separately advised travelers to check with their air carrier for flight-specific delay information and directed readers seeking current operational information to its live air traffic status service. The daily report should therefore be read as a system-level planning snapshot, not as the final status of a particular itinerary. A separate FAA announcement from June 22 provides earlier context on how the agency plans to improve traffic-flow management through Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, known as SMART. According to the FAA, SMART will continuously analyze airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The shared view is intended to help the FAA, airlines and operators coordinate routes and departure and arrival times. The FAA said initial operations using SMART are planned for fall 2026. The June modernization announcement and the July 28 daily report address different time horizons: the former describes a future traffic-management tool, while the latter records weather-related operational risks for that day. The FAA did not state that the July 28 report was produced by SMART. Thunderstorms could delay flights in Charlotte, Denver, Philadelphia, Florida, New York and Washington, D.C. a-20260728-1735-kumamoto-earthquake-taiw.text: 熊本強震擾亂台日航班 華航、星宇轉降福岡 虎航兩班延至翌日 日本熊本縣7月28日發生規模7.1強震,熊本機場關閉跑道檢查,華航CI194與星宇JX316轉降福岡;台灣虎航IT794及IT767延至翌日。華航並公布熊本航線退改票安排,另將免費載運賑災物資至8月底。 日本熊本縣7月28日發生規模7.1強震後,熊本機場一度關閉跑道進行檢查,原定由台灣飛往熊本的多個航班因此改變運行。媒體引述航空公司說法指出,華航CI194桃園—熊本航班在空中等待後轉降福岡;星宇航空JX316台中—熊本航班也改降福岡國際機場。 台灣虎航受影響的航班為IT794台南—熊本及IT767熊本—高雄,航空公司當時表示,兩班預計延後至翌日飛航,實際時間仍須視熊本機場跑道與地面作業恢復情況而定。由於現場狀態持續變化,旅客應以航空公司及機場最新公告為準,不宜只依即時討論或航班追蹤畫面判斷最終行程。 華航另針對熊本航線公布旅客處理方案。凡持有2026年8月5日前(含)往返熊本機票者,若將訂位更改至福岡或鹿兒島、並選擇原受影響航班日期前後14天內的航班,或申請退票,可依公告免收相關手續費。旅客可洽原開票旅行社、華航客服中心或各地分公司辦理;個別機票是否符合條件,仍以航空公司審核結果為準。 除旅客安排外,華航表示將提供航空運輸資源,免費載運賑災物資至8月底,配合政府機關、公益團體、宗教團體及相關救援組織辦理賑災工作。相關物資的收件、運送條件與實際班次安排,應由申請單位依華航及主管機關後續作業確認。 旅遊討論區在地震後出現旅客回報與航班動向資訊,反映事件初期資訊更新快速,但相關貼文與留言不是航空公司或機場的正式通知。AVWIRE因此只將討論區內容作為時序背景,航班轉降、延後及退改票措施均以航空公司說法與可交叉確認的媒體報導為主要依據。 Kumamoto Earthquake Disrupts Taiwan Flights as China Airlines and Starlux Divert to Fukuoka A magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto on July 28 prompted a runway inspection at Kumamoto Airport. China Airlines flight CI194 and Starlux flight JX316 diverted to Fukuoka, while Tigerair Taiwan flights IT794 and IT767 were postponed until the following day. China Airlines also announced ticket flexibility and free transport of relief supplies through the end of August. A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Japan's Kumamoto Prefecture on July 28, prompting Kumamoto Airport to close its runway temporarily for inspection and disrupting several flights from Taiwan. According to airline statements reported by local media, China Airlines flight CI194 from Taipei Taoyuan to Kumamoto held before diverting to Fukuoka. Starlux Airlines flight JX316 from Taichung to Kumamoto also diverted to Fukuoka International Airport. Tigerair Taiwan identified two affected services: IT794 from Tainan to Kumamoto and IT767 from Kumamoto to Kaohsiung. The airline said at the time that both flights were expected to operate the following day, subject to the reopening of the runway and the restoration of ground operations at Kumamoto Airport. Because conditions were changing, passengers were advised to rely on current airline and airport notices rather than treating live discussions or flight-tracking images as final operational decisions. China Airlines separately announced special handling for passengers booked to or from Kumamoto through August 5, 2026. Eligible passengers changing to a Fukuoka or Kagoshima service within 14 days before or after the affected flight date, or requesting a refund, may have the applicable handling fees waived under the notice. Passengers should contact the original issuing travel agency, a China Airlines service center or a local branch; eligibility remains subject to the airline's review. The airline also said it would provide air transport capacity for relief supplies free of charge through the end of August, working with government agencies, charities, religious groups and relevant rescue organizations. Acceptance requirements, shipment arrangements and available capacity will depend on subsequent coordination with China Airlines and the responsible authorities. Travel-forum discussions carried rapid eyewitness and flight-movement updates after the earthquake, but posts and comments are not official airline or airport notices. AVWIRE therefore uses the forum material only as timeline context; the reported diversions, postponements and ticket measures are based primarily on airline statements and corroborating media reports. metadata.title: 波音737 MAX 7與MAX 10完成飛行測試 朝2027年交機邁進

a-20260728-2114-boeing-completes-737-max.text: 波音737 MAX 7與MAX 10完成飛行測試 朝2027年交機邁進 波音公司表示,737 MAX 7與737 MAX 10兩款機型已於7月完成認證飛行測試,仍預期在2026年取得認證、2027年展開首架交機。該消息與波音第二季財報一同揭露。 波音公司旗下737 MAX家族中最後兩款等待認證的機型——737 MAX 7與737 MAX 10——已正式完成認證飛行測試。該訊息由波音在2026年第二季財報中揭露,Simple Flying於7月28日報導指出,兩款衍生機型是MAX家族中最後尚待取證的機型。 波音在財報中表示,截至7月,737-7與737-10的認證飛行測試均已完竣,公司持續預期兩款機型將在2026年取得認證,並在2027年進行首次交付。同一份財報亦揭露波音第二季營收為246億美元。 737 MAX 7與MAX 10分別為MAX系列中機身最短與最長的版本,兩者完成飛行測試意味著波音在MAX全產品線商業化進程上取得階段性進展,但實際投入營運時間仍需視監管機構最終審查進度而定。 Boeing Completes 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 Flight Testing, Clearing Path for 2027 Deliveries Boeing has completed certification flight testing on the 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 as of July, and continues to anticipate certification in 2026 with first deliveries in 2027 for both variants, according to the company's second quarter financial release. The Boeing Company has completed certification flight testing on both the 737 MAX 7 and 737 MAX 10, marking a significant step for the final two variants of the MAX family awaiting regulatory approval. The development was disclosed in Boeing's second quarter 2026 financial results and reported by Simple Flying on 28 July. According to Boeing, 'As of July, certification flight testing has been completed on both the 737-7 and 737-10. The company continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants.' The Q2 results also showed revenue of $24.6 billion and 171 commercial airplane deliveries. The 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 are the smallest and largest members of the MAX family respectively. Completion of flight testing allows Boeing to proceed with the final certification documentation, though the actual timelines remain subject to regulatory review. Simple Flying報導波音已完成737 MAX 7與MAX 10飛行測試,為2027年交機鋪路。 Boeing Completes 737 MAX 7 & MAX 10 Flight Testing, Clearing Path For 2027 Deliveries 737 MAX 7與MAX 10是MAX家族中最後兩款等待認證的衍生機型。 The two variants are the last of the MAX family awaiting certification. 截至7月,波音已完成737-7與737-10的認證飛行測試,仍預期2026年認證、2027年首架交付。 As of July, certification flight testing has been completed on both the 737-7 and 737-10. a-20260728-2307-emirates-a380-diverts-ov.text: 阿聯酋航空A380深夜備降乘客滯留10小時無空調 根據Simple Flying報導,阿聯酋航空一架A380客機因故深夜備降,乘客在機艙內滯留超過十小時,期間空調失效,最終乘客抵達上海。 根據Simple Flying的報導,阿聯酋航空的一架A380客機在深夜因故備降,導致乘客在機艙內滯留超過十小時,期間空調失效。備降發生在深夜,飛機在地面上停靠,乘客忍受著沒有冷卻的環境。 乘客整夜留在機艙坡道上,最終抵達上海。報導指出,該航班載有373名乘客,他們在非計劃停靠期間長時間沒有機艙空調。 該報導於2026年7月28日由Simple Flying發布,網址為https://simpleflying.com/373-passengers-stranded-10-hours-emirates-a380-diversion/。來源未提供其他額外細節。 Emirates A380 Diverts Overnight, Passengers Stranded Over 10 Hours Without Air Conditioning According to Simple Flying, an Emirates A380 aircraft experienced a late-night diversion, resulting in passengers being stranded on board for over ten hours without air conditioning. The diversion occurred late at night, and the aircraft remained on the ground while passengers endured the lack of cooling. Passengers stayed on the aircraft on the ramp throughout the night and eventually reached Shanghai after the incident was resolved. a-20260729-0638-taiwan-tracks-8-pla-airc.text: 國防部偵獲共機14架次與共艦9艘 6架次逾越海峽中線 國防部表示,自8月5日上午6時至8月6日上午6時止,共偵獲14架次共機、9艘共艦及7艘公務船在台海周邊活動。其中有6架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線,侵擾中部、西南及東部空域。國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控並妥善應處。 台灣國防部於2026年8月6日上午發布最新國軍監控軍事動態統計指出,統計自8月5日上午6時起至8月6日上午6時止,在台灣海峽及周邊區域共計偵獲中共軍機14架次、共艦9艘,以及7艘公務船持續進行活動。 國防部進一步說明,在上述偵獲的中共軍機中,計有6架次逾越台灣海峽中線,進入台灣中部、西南及東部空域持續活動。針對中共軍機與艦艇動態,國軍已運用任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。 Taiwan Detects 14 PLA Aircraft and 9 Naval Vessels Around Island Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 14 Chinese military aircraft, nine naval vessels, and seven official ships operating around the island between 06:00 on August 5 and 06:00 on August 6, 2026. According to official figures, six of the aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's central, southwestern, and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat air patrols, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the military activity around the Taiwan Strait. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its daily military tracking report on the morning of August 6, 2026. The ministry stated that between 06:00 on August 5 and 06:00 on August 6, a total of 14 Chinese military aircraft, nine PLAN naval vessels, and seven official ships were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait and surrounding maritime areas. According to the defense authorities, six of the detected aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's central, southwestern, and eastern airspace. In response to the presence of Chinese aircraft and vessels, the Republic of China Armed Forces deployed air patrol aircraft, naval ships, and land-based missile systems to maintain close surveillance and respond accordingly. a-20260729-1207-air-zimbabwe-launches-ne.text: 蓋特威克機場迎新航線 辛巴威航空開通哈拉雷直飛服務 根據 Simple Flying 報導,辛巴威航空已開通由倫敦蓋特威克機場直飛哈拉雷的長途航線,該直飛航程營運時間約為十一小時。這項新服務的營運,進一步拓展了倫敦蓋特威克機場的非洲航線網路,為旅客提供最新的跨洲直飛選擇。 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導,辛巴威航空(Air Zimbabwe)已正式開通由倫敦蓋特威克機場(London Gatwick Airport)直飛哈拉雷(Harare)的全新長途航線。該航線的開通為往返英國與辛巴威之間的旅客提供了直飛選擇。 根據報導內容,這項全新開通的航線屬於跨洲長途飛行,單程直飛飛行時間長達十一小時。該服務展現了長途航線營運的最新發展。 此外,隨著辛巴威航空開啟哈拉雷直飛航線,倫敦蓋特威克機場的非洲航線網絡範圍也隨之進一步擴展。這項新航線也為蓋特威克機場的國際航線網路注入了新的營運網絡動能。 Air Zimbabwe Launches New Nonstop Long-Haul Flight Between London Gatwick and Harare According to media coverage by Simple Flying, Air Zimbabwe has launched new nonstop long-haul flights connecting London Gatwick Airport with Harare. The newly launched service operates direct long-distance flights between the two airports, establishing a regular transport link. The introduction of these direct flights expands air connectivity options for travelers flying on the long-haul route between London Gatwick Airport and Harare. a-20260729-1207-taiwan-caa-to-raise-airp.text: 交通部民航局宣布8月1日起調高16處機場消防人員危險加給 交通部民用航空局7月29日表示,行政院已核定調高機場消防人員危險職務加給,並訂於8月1日起生效。民航局所屬16處機場將區分為兩級,其中第一級每月支領9,700元,第二級每月支領7,760元。民航局指出,各機場均依國際民航組織(ICAO)標準配置專責消防人力。 交通部民用航空局於2026年7月29日宣布,為反映機場消防人員勤務之專業性與危險繁重現況,行政院已核定調高機場消防人員的危險職務加給,該項新方案將自8月1日起正式生效。 民航局表示,其所屬的16處機場將分為兩個層級。其中,第一級機場消防人員每月可支領9,700元加給,第二級機場消防人員每月則可支領7,760元加給。 民航局指出,全台各機場均為國家重要基礎設施,必須依據國際民航組織(ICAO)標準配置專責機場消防人力,以隨時因應各類突發狀況,確保營運與飛航安全。 Taiwan CAA to Raise Airport Firefighter Allowance Across 16 Airports from August 1 Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on July 29, 2026, that the Executive Yuan has approved an increase in hazardous duty allowances for airport firefighters, effective August 1. Under the approved plan, the CAA's 16 managed airports will be categorized into two tiers, with Tier 1 firefighters receiving NT$9,700 per month and Tier 2 receiving NT$7,760 per month. The CAA noted that dedicated airport firefighting personnel are deployed across Taiwan's airports in accordance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards to maintain flight safety and operational emergency response capabilities. Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on July 29, 2026, that the Executive Yuan has approved an adjustment to increase the hazardous duty allowance for airport firefighting personnel, taking effect on August 1. a-20260729-1532-iata-global-air-cargo-de.text: IATA:2026年6月全球航空客運需求年減1.7%,貨運成長8.5% IATA公布2026年6月數據,全球客運需求(RPK)較2025年同期下降1.7%,主因為中國、美國及日本國內市場下滑;中東航空業者國際需求年減14%,但降幅較前月縮小。同期全球航空貨運需求(CTK)年增8.5%,所有地區均呈正成長,以北美洲業者13.1%增幅最大。 國際航空運輸協會(IATA)公布2026年6月全球航空客運市場數據。以營收客公里(RPK)計算,總需求較2025年6月下降1.7%;若排除中東地區,需求降幅為0.6%。總運能以可用座位公里(ASK)計算年減1.3%,載客率為84.2%,較2025年6月減少0.4個百分點。 國際客運需求年減0.9%,排除中東地區則為年增1.1%。國內客運需求年減3.0%,運能年減2.4%,載客率84.0%,較2025年6月減少0.5個百分點。IATA理事長Willie Walsh表示,整體下滑主因為中國、美國及日本國內市場衰退,以及中東航空業者國際需求雖有改善但仍疲弱。 區域表現方面,亞太航空業者國際需求年增0.4%,歐洲業者年增1.5%,拉丁美洲業者年增3.5%,非洲業者年增6.7%。中東航空業者國際需求年減14%,運能年減11%,載客率76.3%,較2025年6月減少2.6個百分點;IATA指出伊朗戰爭持續造成高度負面的年比比較,但自4月以來月降幅已減半。北美洲業者國際需求年減1.0%。 國內市場方面,巴西國內流量年增0.9%,澳洲持平,其餘主要市場皆下滑,其中以中國(-5.2%)及日本(-3.8%)跌幅最大。IATA表示,較高的燃料價格可能是原因。 貨運方面,IATA同日稍早公布2026年6月全球航空貨運市場數據。以貨運噸公里(CTK)計算,總需求較2025年6月成長8.5%,國際營運成長9.6%。運能以可用貨運噸公里(ACTK)計算年增4.4%。需求成長在所有地區均為正值,以北美洲業者13.1%增幅最大,拉丁美洲及加勒比海地區3.5%增幅最小。 Willie Walsh表示,航空貨運需求成長超越全球貿易增速,受高價值科技產品及急件運輸帶動,但中東持續衝突及美國重新關注關稅等風險仍在。全球貿易年增5.2%。噴射燃料價格6月月減20%,但仍較2025年同期高出45.8%。 IATA: Global Air Passenger Demand Down 1.7% in June 2026, Cargo Up 8.5% IATA reported that total air passenger demand (RPK) fell 1.7% year-on-year in June 2026, driven by domestic market declines in China, the US, and Japan. Middle East carriers saw a 14% international demand decline, though the rate of decline halved since April. Global air cargo demand (CTK) rose 8.5% year-on-year, with all regions in positive territory and North American carriers posting the strongest growth at 13.1%. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) released June 2026 global air passenger market data. Total demand, measured in revenue passenger kilometers (RPK), was down 1.7% compared to June 2025. Excluding the Middle East, demand declined by 0.6%. Total capacity, measured in available seat kilometers (ASK), decreased 1.3% year-on-year, with a load factor of 84.2%, down 0.4 percentage points from June 2025. International demand fell 0.9% year-on-year, while excluding the Middle East it grew by 1.1%. Domestic demand contracted 3.0% compared to June 2025, with capacity down 2.4% and load factor at 84.0%, down 0.5 percentage points. IATA Director General Willie Walsh attributed the overall decline to domestic market contractions in China, the US, and Japan, alongside weak but improving international demand for Middle East carriers. By region, Asia-Pacific carriers saw international demand rise 0.4% year-on-year, European carriers 1.5%, Latin American carriers 3.5%, and African carriers 6.7%. Middle Eastern carriers experienced a 14% year-on-year demand decline, with capacity down 11% and load factor at 76.3%, down 2.6 percentage points. IATA noted that the Iran war continues to cause a highly negative year-on-year comparison, but the rate of decline halved month-to-month since April. North American carriers saw international demand decrease 1.0%. In domestic markets, Brazil traffic was up 0.9% and Australia was flat, while all other major markets declined. The steepest falls were in China (-5.2%) and Japan (-3.8%), with IATA citing higher fuel prices as the likely reason. Separately, IATA released June 2026 global air cargo market data. Total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers (CTK), increased by 8.5% compared to June 2025, with international operations up 9.6%. Capacity, measured in available cargo tonne-kilometers (ACTK), rose 4.4%. Demand growth was positive in all regions, led by North American carriers at 13.1%, with Latin America and the Caribbean the weakest at 3.5%. Walsh said air cargo demand growth outpaced global trade, supported by high-value technology products and urgent shipments, but noted continuing risks from Middle East hostilities and renewed US tariff focus. Global trade increased by 5.2% year-on-year. Jet fuel prices fell 20% month-on-month in June but remained 45.8% above year-earlier levels. metadata.title: 波音完成737-7與737-10認證飛行測試 朝2027年交機推進

a-20260729-1652-boeing-wraps-up-737-7-an.text: 波音完成737-7與737-10認證飛行測試 朝2027年交機推進 波音宣布已完成737 MAX家族最小型號737-7與最大型號737-10的認證飛行測試,仍預期兩款衍生機型於2026年獲得認證、2027年首架交付。 波音公司已完成旗下737 MAX系列中機身最短的737-7與機身最長的737-10兩款客機的認證飛行測試。該公司在7月28日發布的第二季財報中確認此里程碑,並表示持續預期兩款衍生機型於2026年取得認證、2027年開始交付客戶。 AeroTime於7月29日報導指出,波音已完成這兩款最小與最大737 MAX客機的規劃認證飛行測試。737-7與737-10是MAX家族最後兩款等待認證的型號。 波音第二季商用飛機部門交出171架飛機,並取得包含大韓航空、達美航空與SMBC Capital在內的246架淨訂單。截至季末,公司總積壓訂單增至破紀錄的7,150億美元,其中包含超過6,200架商用飛機。 Boeing wraps up 737-7 and 737-10 certification flight tests, keeping 2027 delivery target Boeing has completed planned certification flight testing of the smallest and largest 737 MAX variants, the 737-7 and 737-10, and continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both types. Boeing has rounded off certification flight tests for the smallest and largest members of the 737 MAX family, the 737-7 and 737-10. The milestone was confirmed in the company's second-quarter earnings release on July 28, which stated that testing had been completed as of July and that Boeing continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants. AeroTime reported on July 29 that Boeing had completed planned certification flight tests of the two jets, noting the 737-7 and 737-10 are the last of the MAX family awaiting certification. During the second quarter, Boeing Commercial Airplanes delivered 171 aircraft and booked 246 net orders, including business from Korean Air, Delta Air Lines and SMBC Capital. The total company backlog reached a record US$715 billion by quarter-end, including more than 6,200 commercial airplanes. As of July, certification flight testing has been completed on both the 737-7 and 737-10, with certification anticipated in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants. a-20260729-1742-us-marine-corps-receives.text: 美國海軍陸戰隊接收第359架暨最後一架MV-22B魚鷹傾轉旋翼機 根據AeroTime報導,美國海軍陸戰隊已接收第359架暨最後一架Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機,正式完成該型機的交付計畫。Bell Boeing完成該架機體交付後,海軍陸戰隊的MV-22機隊計畫全數結案。 根據航空新聞媒體AeroTime報導,美國海軍陸戰隊已正式接收第359架、同時也是最後一架Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機。此項交付代表著美國海軍陸戰隊該型傾轉旋翼機計畫的正式完成。 Bell Boeing在交付這架機號為第359架的MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機後,完成全數機隊的交付流程。這項訊息由AeroTime報導發布,確認了該機型採購計畫的最終交付狀態。 US Marine Corps Receives 359th and Final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey The US Marine Corps has received its 359th and final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey tiltrotor aircraft, bringing the service's long-running procurement program to an official completion. According to details reported by aviation news outlet AeroTime, the final aircraft delivery marks the end of scheduled handovers for the tiltrotor platform to the Marine Corps. With this milestone delivery, manufacturer Bell Boeing has fulfilled all planned aircraft units under the established MV-22 program schedule. The United States Marine Corps has received its 359th and final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey tiltrotor aircraft, marking the official completion of the military branch's tiltrotor program. The delivery represents the final aircraft scheduled for handover to the service under the MV-22 procurement schedule, as reported by aviation news outlet AeroTime. The handover of the 359th aircraft by manufacturers Bell and Boeing concludes the delivery phase for the US Marine Corps MV-22B Osprey fleet. With this final delivery accomplished, the long-standing tiltrotor procurement program has now reached full completion, according to details published by AeroTime. a-20260730-0314-cessna-citation-cj3-gen3.text: Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 於 Wichita 完成首飛 Textron Aviation 宣布 Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 原型機於 2026 年 7 月 29 日自 Wichita 起飛,進行近兩小時的首飛,最大高度達 41,000 英尺,正式展開飛測階段,目標取得 FAA 認證並於 2027 年投入服務。 Textron Aviation 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日宣布,Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 原型機完成首次飛行,標誌該輕型商務噴射機進入飛行測試階段。該機自 Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport 起飛,飛行時間近兩小時。 試飛員 Steve Helmer 與 Dave Welbrock 在此次飛行中主要評估駕駛艙軟體。飛機最大高度達 41,000 英尺,最高指示空速為 278 節。Helmer 表示,從起飛到降落,飛機展現了預期的操控品質與系統性能,為後續擴大測試與認證計畫奠定基礎。 CJ3 Gen3 保留 Garmin G3000 航電平台,並新增 Garmin 自動油門與 Emergency Autoland 功能。Emergency Autoland 可在飛行員失能時接管飛機、選擇合適機場、與航管通訊並在無飛行員介入下自動降落。Textron 另提供選配的增強視覺系統,以提升低能見度下的環境警覺能力。 Textron 將展開更廣泛的飛測活動,朝 FAA 認證與投入服務邁進。此次首飛意味 Textron 次世代 Citation 輕型噴射機系列三款機型均已進入飛行測試,其中 Citation CJ4 Gen3 已於 2024 年 10 月首飛,Citation M2 Gen3 則於 2026 年稍早完成首飛。 Textron 於 2024 年拉斯維加斯 NBAA 商務航空大會暨展覽中,與 M2 Gen3 及 CJ4 Gen3 一同發表 CJ3 Gen3。公司表示 CJ3 Gen3 與 M2 Gen3 預計於 2027 年投入服務。 Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 Completes First Flight in Wichita Textron Aviation announced the first flight of the Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 prototype on July 29, 2026, from Wichita, lasting nearly two hours and reaching 41,000 feet. The light business jet enters flight testing as Textron works toward FAA certification and entry into service in 2027. Textron Aviation announced on July 29, 2026 that the first Cessna Citation CJ3 Gen3 prototype had completed its initial flight, moving the light business jet into the start of its flight-testing phase. The aircraft departed from Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport in Kansas for a flight lasting nearly two hours. Test pilots Steve Helmer and Dave Welbrock focused primarily on evaluating cockpit software during the flight. The aircraft reached a maximum altitude of 41,000 feet and a top indicated airspeed of 278 knots. Helmer said the aircraft demonstrated the handling qualities and system performance the team expected, providing a strong foundation for expanded testing and the certification program. The CJ3 Gen3 retains the Garmin G3000 avionics platform while adding Garmin autothrottles and Emergency Autoland. Emergency Autoland can take control of the aircraft if the pilot becomes incapacitated, select a suitable airport, communicate with air traffic control and land without pilot input. Textron also offers an optional enhanced vision system designed to improve situational awareness in reduced visibility. Textron will now begin a broader flight-test campaign as it works toward Federal Aviation Administration certification and entry into service. metadata.title: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury無人機摧毀目標 仍需人工批准方可發射

a-20260730-0603-anduril-yfq-44a-fury-dro.text: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury無人機摧毀目標 仍需人工批准方可發射 根據 Simple Flying 報導,Anduril 開發的 YFQ-44A Fury 無人機近期在測試中摧毀目標,證實其作戰能力。然而,在美國空軍未來的相關作戰任務中,該款新式戰鬥無人機仍必須由人員進行確認與批准,方能執行發射命令。 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導,由 Anduril 開發的 YFQ-44A Fury 無人機近期在作業中成功摧毀預定目標,以此證實了該型戰鬥無人機具備相應的攻擊與任務執行能力。 然而,針對這款美國空軍的新型戰鬥無人機,未來的作戰部署與相關任務執行仍受限於防護規範。即使 YFQ-44A Fury 已證實其打擊能力,系統在沒有獲得操作人員明確批准與授權的情況下,依然無法直接進行武器發射,確保人工機制始終參與控制流程。 Anduril YFQ-44A Fury Drone Destroys Target But Still Requires Human Approval to Fire According to reporting by Simple Flying, Anduril's YFQ-44A Fury drone recently successfully destroyed a target, providing proof of its operational combat capability. However, despite proving what the uncrewed aircraft can achieve, human operators must remain directly in the command loop for future operations involving the US Air Force's combat drone fleet. As a result of these established operational rules, the new combat drone still cannot fire weapons without receiving explicit human authorization prior to engagement. According to reporting published by Simple Flying, the YFQ-44A Fury combat drone developed by defense technology company Anduril recently destroyed a target during field tests. The trial successfully demonstrated the uncrewed aircraft's technical capability to engage and destroy targets. Despite the successful demonstration proving what the aircraft can achieve, operational requirements for the US Air Force mandate that a human operator must remain in the decision loop during future deployments. Under these rules, the new combat drone cannot fire any weapons without receiving explicit prior approval from human personnel. a-20260730-0603-philippine-airlines-rece.text: 菲律賓航空接收第三架A350-1000 將飛馬尼拉-舊金山 菲律賓航空於2026年7月29日從圖盧茲接收第三架A350-1000(註冊號RP-C3512),新機將於8月5日首航馬尼拉至舊金山,初期每週三班,9月轉為每日,使菲航成為東南亞唯一營運該機型的航空公司。 菲律賓航空於2026年7月29日從空中巴士圖盧茲交付中心接收第三架A350-1000,註冊號為RP-C3512,抵達馬尼拉後將完成法規與運作準備。 該機型為菲航長程旗艦,配備最新商務、豪華經濟及經濟艙,且較舊機型具備更佳燃油效率、更低排放與更大貨艙容量。 新機計劃於8月5日首航馬尼拉至舊金山航線,初期每週二、五、日各一班,9月轉為每日班次。 此舉使菲律賓航空成為東南亞首家且目前唯一營運A350-1000的航空公司。 Philippine Airlines receives third A350-1000, to launch Manila–San Francisco service Philippine Airlines took delivery of its third Airbus A350-1000 on 29 July 2026, registration RP-C3512, arriving in Manila from Toulouse. The aircraft will debut on the Manila–San Francisco route on 5 August 2026, initially three weekly flights (Tue, Fri, Sun) before daily service in September, making PAL the first and only Southeast Asian carrier operating the A350-1000. metadata.title: 達美航空於明尼蘇達州啟用SAF摻配設施 強化明尼阿波利斯樞紐永續燃料供應

a-20260730-0603-delta-marks-new-saf-blen.text: 達美航空於明尼蘇達州啟用SAF摻配設施 強化明尼阿波利斯樞紐永續燃料供應 達美航空與明尼蘇達州官員於7月27日共同標誌Flint Hills Resources煉油廠內一座全新永續航空燃料摻配設施完工啟用。該設施可將純SAF與傳統燃油混合後,經既有管線輸往達美第二大樞紐明尼蘇達波利斯聖保羅國際機場(MSP),預計全面運轉後每年可摻配3千萬加侖純SAF。 達美航空於2026年7月27日,與明尼蘇達州政商界人士一同為Flint Hills Resources Pine Bend煉油廠內一座新設燃油摻配設施舉行完工儀式,此設施目的在於為明尼蘇達波利斯聖保羅國際機場(MSP)挹注更多永續航空燃料(SAF)。 MSP為達美航空第二大樞紐,每年消耗約2.5億加侖航空燃油。達美航空與Flint Hills Resources最初於2024年9月宣布該摻配設施計劃,如今該設施允許SAF於煉油廠端直接與標準航空燃油混合,並藉由既有管線輸往機場。 一旦全面運轉,此設施預計每年可摻配最高3,000萬加侖的純SAF。SAF係以再生原料製造,可顯著降低全生命週期的碳排放,且無需修改便可直接用於現今的飛機引擎及多數機場既有的輸儲系統。 達美航空總裁Peter Carter表示,此設施是多年來共同願景的成果,目標是讓明尼蘇達在永續航空燃料領域取得領先地位,並藉由擴大基礎建設支持更廣泛的SAF採用,將潛力轉化為現實。 啟用儀式現場出席者包括達美航空總裁Peter Carter、Flint Hills Resources總裁兼執行長Francis Murphy、Ecolab代表Nick Alfano、Greater MSP代表Peter Frosch、美國參議員Amy Klobuchar、州長Tim Walz、眾議員Brad Finstad、議長Lisa Demuth及參議員Ann Rest等。 此設施屬於明尼蘇達SAF Hubs的一項里程碑,該聯盟由達美航空於2023年攜手Greater MSP Partnership、美國銀行、Ecolab與Xcel Energy共同發起。噴氣燃料約佔達美航空碳排放的90%,該公司已設定2030年使用10%SAF、並在2050年達成淨零排放的目標。 Delta Marks New SAF Blending Facility Opening at Minneapolis-St. Paul Airport Hub Delta Air Lines and Minnesota officials marked the completion of a new sustainable aviation fuel blending facility at Flint Hills Resources' Pine Bend Refinery on July 27, 2026. The facility allows SAF to be blended with standard jet fuel on-site and piped directly to Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, Delta's second-largest hub, and is expected to blend up to 30 million gallons of neat SAF annually once running at full capacity. Delta Air Lines gathered with Minnesota officials on July 27, 2026, to mark the completion of a new fuel blending facility at Flint Hills Resources' Pine Bend Refinery, a project intended to bring more sustainable aviation fuel to Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport (MSP), Delta's second-largest hub. Sustainable aviation fuel is made from renewable feedstocks and can cut lifecycle carbon emissions significantly compared to regular jet fuel. The new facility allows SAF to be blended with standard jet fuel right at the refinery, then delivered to MSP through pipelines that are already in place. Delta burns through roughly 250 million gallons of jet fuel a year at MSP alone. Once running at full capacity, the facility is expected to blend up to 30 million gallons of pure SAF annually. Delta and Flint Hills Resources first announced the plan back in September 2024. Delta President Peter Carter called the facility the result of years of work toward a shared goal. "This facility is the culmination of a shared vision for Minnesota to become a leader in sustainable aviation fuel," he said. "By expanding the infrastructure needed to support broader SAF adoption, it represents an important step toward turning that potential into reality." The opening brought out figures including Flint Hills President and CEO Francis Murphy, Ecolab's Nick Alfano, Greater MSP's Peter Frosch, US Senator Amy Klobuchar, Governor Tim Walz, Congressman Brad Finstad, Speaker Lisa Demuth, and Senator Ann Rest. The facility is one of four milestones tied to the Minnesota SAF Hub, a coalition Delta helped launch in 2023 alongside the Greater MSP Partnership, Bank of America, Ecolab, and Xcel Energy to grow a regional SAF supply. Jet fuel accounts for around 90% of Delta's carbon emissions, and the airline has a goal of running on 10% SAF by 2030 toward net zero emissions by 2050. 達美航空於2026年7月27日與明尼蘇達州官員在Flint Hills Resources的Pine Bend煉油廠,為一座新的燃油摻配設施完工舉行儀式。 Delta Air Lines gathered with Minnesota officials on July 27, 2026, to mark the completion of a new fuel blending facility at Flint Hills Resources’ Pine Bend Refinery. 此設施可於煉油廠將SAF與標準航空燃油混合,並透過既有管線輸送至明尼阿波利斯聖保羅國際機場(MSP)。 The new facility lets SAF be blended with standard jet fuel right at the refinery, then delivered to MSP through pipelines that are already in place. 全面運轉後,該設施預計每年可將高達3,000萬加侖的純SAF進行摻配。 once running at full capacity, the facility is expected to blend up to 30 million gallons of pure SAF annually 達美航空於此機場每年消耗約2.5億加侖航空燃油。 Delta burns through roughly 250 million gallons of jet fuel a year at that airport alone 達美航空與Flint Hills Resources最初於2024年9月宣布此計劃。 Delta and Flint Hills Resources first announced the plan back in September 2024. 達美航空設定2030年使用10%SAF的目標,作為其2050年達成淨零排放長遠努力的一部分。 the airline has set a goal of running on 10% SAF by 2030 as part of its longer-term push toward net zero emissions by 2050

Among them, 16 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and its extension, entering airspace off northern, central, southwestern, and eastern Taiwan. According to the ministry, the aircraft operated alongside naval vessels in a so-called joint combat readiness patrol. In response, Taiwan's armed forces monitored the situation using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance systems, and dispatched aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems. metadata.title: 波音777-9測試機隊時數達4800小時 第7架將進行ETOPS認證

a-20260730-0841-boeing-777-9-test-fleet-.text: 波音777-9測試機隊時數達4800小時 第7架將進行ETOPS認證 根據Simple Flying報導,波音777-9型客機測試機隊的累計測試飛行時間已達到4800小時。同時,一架剛出廠的第7架測試機體將加入機隊,並負責執行雙發延程飛行(ETOPS)認證相關測試,持續推進該機型的驗證程序。 根據Simple Flying報導,波音777-9型客機測試機隊的測試飛行總時間已正式達到4800小時。相關測試數據記錄了該型雙引擎客機在認證過程中的持續飛行進展。 報導指出,一架剛出廠的全新飛機正加入這支持續擴大中的測試機隊。作為該計畫中的第7架機體,該架飛機後續將負責執行雙發延程飛行(ETOPS)認證相關任務。 隨著第7架機體的投入,該測試機隊將執行專門的ETOPS認證測試,以在先前累積的4800小時飛行測試基礎上,繼續完成波音777-9的後續認證程序。 作為這項進度的背景,波音於7月28日表示,777X計畫已獲美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)批准,在型別檢驗授權(Type Inspection Authorization)4B下展開認證試飛,並持續預期於2027年首次交付。 Boeing 777-9 Test Fleet Reaches 4,800 Hours as 7th Aircraft Prepares for ETOPS Certification According to report material from Simple Flying, the Boeing 777-9 test aircraft fleet has successfully accumulated a total of 4,800 test flight hours during its ongoing flight testing activities. metadata.title: AeroVironment展示Mayhem 10無人機蜂群協同作戰能力

a-20260730-0841-aerovironment-and-applie.text: AeroVironment展示Mayhem 10無人機蜂群協同作戰能力 AeroVironment與Applied Intuition於2026年7月29日宣布達成戰略合作協議,將Acuity ISR/Strike自主軟體整合至Mayhem 10發射效果系統。雙方近期已完成現場技術演示,展示由單一操作員監督多架Mayhem 10無人飛行載具同步動作並執行蜂群協同作業,該項技術開發主要用於支援美國陸軍的發射效果計畫需求。 無人機製造商 AeroVironment 與自主軟體開發商 Applied Intuition 於 2026 年 7 月 29 日宣布達成戰略合作協議,將 Applied Intuition 的 Acuity ISR/Strike 自主控制軟體整合至 AeroVironment 的 Mayhem 10 發射效果系統。這項技術整合旨在讓多架 Mayhem 10 無人飛行載具能夠共享目標定位資訊,並在威脅環境發生變化時即時調整行動,以執行尋找、追蹤與打擊目標的協同作戰任務。 AeroVironment 表示,兩家公司近期已完成一項技術演示,多架 Mayhem 10 系統成功同步飛行動作並以蜂群模式運作,同時適應不同的威脅情境。在該控制架構下,整組蜂群無人機由單一操作員進行全域監督,無須讓操作員在整個任務期間對每架無人機進行單獨且直接的手動操控。此項成果是在多個地點進行了數個月的軟硬體系統整合工作後所取得。 這項合作計畫主要支援美國陸軍的「發射效果」計畫。該計畫旨在採購並部署可從有人或無人平台發射的小型無人飛行載具,以擴展軍方在戰場上的偵察監視、目標定位、電子戰以及精準打擊能力。此外,AeroVironment 指出 Mayhem 10 可以在遭遇 GPS 干擾、欺騙及通訊受阻的惡劣環境下持續執行任務。 Mayhem 10 由 AeroVironment 於 2026 年 4 月首度推出,是一款具備模組化設計的無人機,能夠從空中、陸地及海上等多元平台進行發射。該機型採用開放式架構設計,允許第三方廠商在不重新設計整套系統的情況下新增自主軟體與任務酬載。其模組化酬載艙可支援情報偵察、電子防護、通訊中繼、誘餌及精準打擊武器。 在性能規格方面,Mayhem 10 最大可攜帶 10 磅的任務裝備,作戰航程超過 100 公里(約 62 英里)。根據 AeroVironment 公布的資料,該機款續航時間超過 50 分鐘,巡航速度為每小時 80 英里,最高衝刺速度可達每小時 120 英里,且操作人員可在不到 5 分鐘的時間內完成組裝並發射升空。 AeroVironment and Applied Intuition Demonstrate Mayhem 10 Drone Swarm Autonomy AeroVironment and Applied Intuition announced a strategic teaming agreement on July 29, 2026, to integrate Acuity ISR/Strike autonomy software with the Mayhem 10 launched-effects system. The companies completed a flight demonstration showing multiple Mayhem 10 uncrewed aircraft operating as a coordinated swarm under the supervision of a single operator. The joint effort supports the US Army Launched Effects program, which aims to deploy small uncrewed aerial systems from various platforms for surveillance, targeting, and strike operations. metadata.title: 2026上半年全球商務航空起降成長4.2% 持分共享飛行為主要動能

a-20260730-0841-global-business-aviation.text: 2026上半年全球商務航空起降成長4.2% 持分共享飛行為主要動能 根據ARGUS International數據,2026年上半年全球商務航空活動年增4.2%,總起降次數達244萬次。北美市場佔全球總量65%,其中持分共享營運年增11.7%,成為推動成長的主要力量。此外,歐洲市場起降量年增1.6%,佔全球逾14%。 根據ARGUS International發布的最新統計數據,2026年1月至6月期間,全球商務航空活動展現持續成長趨勢,總計完成244萬次起降,較2025年同期成長4.2%。在今年上半年的前六個月中,全球商務航空的單月起降活動均呈現穩定增長。 北美地區持續作為全球商務航空的營運核心,佔全球總起降架次高達65%。該區域在今年上半年共錄得177萬次航班,較2025年同期成長3.5%,創下過去四年來的同期新高紀錄,同時比疫情前的2019年上半年高出15.4%。在北美各類營運型態中,持分共享營運成長最為迅猛,年增11.7%,增加38,808架次航班;包機活動年增3.1%;私人飛行則微增0.3%,但仍以42.9%的占比維持當地最大營運類別。 在ARGUS追蹤的四種主要機型類別中,有三類錄得成長。其中輕型噴射機成長6.1%,為表現最佳的機型類別;渦輪螺旋槳飛機成長4.3%,中型噴射機成長3.2%。大型客艙噴射機則為唯一衰退的類別,較去年同期下降1.8%。此外,歐洲作為全球第二大商務航空市場,上半年起降次數增長1.6%,佔全球總量的14%以上;加拿大則以4.8%的全球占比位居單一國家第二名。 統計數據亦顯示,星期四為商務航空最忙碌的營運日,上半年平均每日錄得11,201架次航班;星期六則為最不忙碌的營運日,平均僅7,545架次。ARGUS預測,2026年下半年北美商務航空活動將再成長2.2%。不過該機構同時警告,燃油價格上漲、地緣政治不確定性以及大型客艙噴射機活動的疲軟,可能成為今年剩餘時間市場發展的潛在風險因子。 Global Business Aviation Activity Rises 4.2% in First Half of 2026, ARGUS Data Shows Global business aviation activity increased by 4.2% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, recording 2.44 million departures worldwide, according to data from ARGUS International. North America remained the largest market with 1.77 million flights, representing 65% of global activity, driven by an 11.7% surge in fractional operations. Europe accounted for slightly over 14% of global departures with a 1.6% increase. Among aircraft classes, light jets posted the strongest growth at 6.1%. Global business aviation activity expanded by 4.2% year-over-year during the first half of 2026, recording a total of 2.44 million departures worldwide from January through June, according to new data published by ARGUS International. Flight departures registered monthly increases in each of the first six months of the year. North America maintained its position as the global hub for business aviation, accounting for 65% of all worldwide departures. Operators completed 1.77 million flights in the region during the six-month period, marking a 3.5% increase compared with the first half of 2025 and representing the highest first-half volume recorded in the past four years. This performance also exceeded the activity level of the first half of 2019 by 15.4%. Fractional operations drove the strongest growth in North America, rising 11.7% and adding 38,808 flights year-over-year. Charter operations increased by 3.1%, while private flying edged up 0.3%. Private operations remained the largest single operational segment, representing 42.9% of total North American flight activity. Across aircraft categories, light jets led gains with a 6.1% increase, followed by turboprops up 4.3% and midsize jets up 3.2%. Large-cabin jets were the sole category to decline, falling 1.8%. Europe, the second-largest market globally, registered a 1.6% rise in flight activity during the first half, accounting for slightly more than 14% of global departures. ARGUS forecasts North American business aviation activity to grow by an additional 2.2% in the second half of 2026, though it noted rising jet fuel prices, geopolitical uncertainty, and weakness in large-cabin jet activity as potential risk factors. 2026年上半年全球商務航空起降次數達244萬次,年增4.2%。 Global business aviation activity increased 4.2% during the first half of 2026 北美占全球起降次數65%達177萬架次,持分共享營運大幅成長11.7%。 North America remained the center of global business aviation activity, accounting for 65% of all departures. 輕型噴射機成長6.1%為機型中最高,大型客艙噴射機則下降1.8%。 Light jet activity increased 6.1%, the strongest result among the aircraft categories. 歐洲起降量占全球逾14%並成長1.6%,加拿大占比為4.8%。 European countries together accounted for slightly more than 14% of global departures. ARGUS預計下半年北美活動成長2.2%,並將燃油價格與地緣政治列為風險。 The company expects North American business aviation activity to increase another 2.2% during the second half of 2026.

metadata.title: IATA、AFRAA、AASA 呼籲非洲政府依國際標準實施 API 與 PNR

a-20260730-1035-iata-afraa-and-aasa-urge.text: IATA、AFRAA、AASA 呼籲非洲政府依國際標準實施 API 與 PNR 國際航空運輸協會、非洲航空公司協會與南部非洲航空公司協會於2026年7月30日聯合發布聲明,呼籲非洲各國依照ICAO標準與全球最佳實務推行預先乘客資訊(API)與乘客姓名記錄(PNR)系統,並要求建立合法框架、僅蒐集必要資料、限定使用目的及採用統一格式;三組織並強調邊境安全成本應由政府承擔,不得向航空公司或旅客轉嫁費用。 國際航空運輸協會(IATA)、非洲航空公司協會(AFRAA)與南部非洲航空公司協會(AASA)於2026年7月30日聯合發布聲明,呼籲非洲各國政府依照國際民航組織(ICAO)標準及全球最佳實務,實施預先乘客資訊(API)與乘客姓名記錄(PNR)系統。 聲明列出四項原則:合法性要求建立符合國際標準的法律框架;相稱性限制僅蒐集必要資料;目的性規定資料僅用於邊境管制、安全執法及嚴重犯罪防範;一致性與準確性要求採用統一全球格式並確保資料安全傳輸與儲存。 三大組織並強調,API與PNR國家邊境安全計畫不應以向航空公司或旅客徵收費用方式融資,引用ICAO《機場與航行服務收費政策》(Doc 9082)指出邊境安全屬政府職責,相關成本應由政府承擔,否則將增加旅行成本、削弱連通性並減損航空帶來的經濟效益。 AFRAA秘書長Abdérahmane Berthé、AASA執行長Aaron Munetsi及IATA非洲中東區域副總裁Kamil Alawadhi在聯合聲明中表示,支持API與PNR資料傳輸,但必須遵循國際公認標準並正確融資,以提升安全成果、簡化旅客流程、保護個資並避免不必要的成本與複雜性。 IATA代表超過370家航空公司,佔全球航空流量約85%,此次呼籲顯示國際航空業界期望非洲各國在推行乘客資料制度時,能兼顧安全與產業發展。 IATA, AFRAA and AASA urge African states to align API and PNR with global standards The International Air Transport Association, the African Airlines Association and the Airlines Association of Southern Africa issued a joint statement on 30 July 2026 urging African governments to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in line with ICAO standards and global best practices. The statement sets out four guiding principles — legality, proportionality, purpose, and consistency and accuracy — and stresses that API and PNR border‐security programmes must be funded by governments, not by charges on airlines or passengers. The International Air Transport Association (IATA), the African Airlines Association (AFRAA) and the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA) issued a joint statement on 30 July 2026 urging African governments to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in line with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards and global best practices. The statement sets out four guiding principles: legality, requiring a clear legal framework aligned with international API and PNR standards; proportionality, limiting data collection to what is necessary for the stated purpose; purpose, restricting use of the data to border control, security, law enforcement and prevention of serious crime; and consistency and accuracy, calling for harmonised global formats and secure storage and transfer of the information. The organisations also warned that API and PNR national border‐security programmes should not be financed through charges levied on airlines or passengers, citing ICAO’s Policies on Charges for Airports and Air Navigation Services (Doc 9082) which state that border security is a government responsibility and related costs must be borne by governments, otherwise travel costs rise, connectivity weakens and the economic benefits of aviation are eroded. AFRAA Secretary General Abdérahmane Berthé, AASA Chief Executive Aaron Munetsi and IATA Regional Vice President for Africa and the Middle East Kamil Alawadhi said in the joint release that they support API and PNR data transfer but stressed that the systems must follow internationally recognised standards and be funded correctly to improve security outcomes, make travel more seamless, protect personal data and avoid unnecessary cost and complexity. IATA represents more than 370 airlines accounting for roughly 85 % of global air traffic, underscoring the industry’s expectation that African states balance security imperatives with the development of a robust aviation sector when rolling out passenger‐data regimes. IATA, AFRAA and AASA jointly urged African States to implement API and PNR systems in accordance with ICAO standards and global best practices. The African Airlines Association (AFRAA), the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA), and the International Air Transport Association (IATA) urged African States to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in accordance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards and global best practices. The statement includes a legality principle requiring a clear legal framework aligned with international API and PNR standards. Legality: Establish a clear legal framework aligned with international API and PNR standards, including applicable bilateral or regional agreements. The organisations urged governments not to fund API and PNR programmes through charges on airlines or passengers. The organizations also urged governments not to fund API and PNR national border security programs through charges imposed on airlines and/or passengers. AFRAA, AASA and IATA leaders said they support API and PNR data transfer but stressed alignment with internationally recognised standards and correct funding. We support the implementation of Advance Passenger Information and Passenger Name Record data transfer and recognize the important role passenger data plays in keeping borders secure. However, these systems must be aligned around internationally recognized standards and funded correctly. IATA represents over 370 airlines accounting for about 85% of global air traffic. IATA (International Air Transport Association) represents over 370 airlines accounting for some 85% of global air traffic.

a-20260730-1149-westjet-issues-lockout-n.text: 西捷航空發出72小時封閉鎖廠通知回應機艙罷工警告 加拿大西捷航空於2026年7月30日發出72小時封閉鎖廠通知,回應加拿大公共員工協會8125分會先前提出的72小時罷工通知。若雙方未能在談判中達成協議,停工可能於8月2日午夜後發生。航空公司已針對7月30日至8月4日期間預訂行程的旅客提供彈性改票與退票政策。 加拿大西捷航空於2026年7月30日正式發出72小時封閉鎖廠通知,回應加拿大公共員工協會(CUPE)8125分會先前代表約4,400名機艙組員提出的72小時罷工通知。若雙方無法在現有勞資談判中達成新的團體協定,潛在的停工行動最早可能於2026年8月2日午夜剛過時正式生效。封閉鎖廠通知一旦生效,將阻止工會會員進入工作崗位。 西捷航空集團行政總裁 Alexis von Hoensbroech 表示,公司在回應工會行動時做出發出鎖廠通知的決定絕非輕率之舉,並對此事持續給旅客帶來的困擾與不確定性深表遺憾。他強調,西捷航空的承諾依然留在談判桌上,管理團隊將全天候持續進行協商,希望能達成一項既能為機艙組員提供價值與實質改善,同時又能維持公司長期永續經營的協議。 工會代表 CUPE 8125 則指出,提出罷工通知並不意味著空服員必然希望啟動工業行動。CUPE 8125 主席 Alia Hussain 表示,工會的目標是在不打擾旅客或旅行大眾的前提下達成公平協議,目前仍有時間避免罷工發生。工會同時主張,西捷航空空服員每月執行長達35小時的未獲薪酬地面工作,包含登機服務、安全檢查、協助乘客與地面延誤等,要求新合約必須終止無薪勞動。 針對可能發生的營運衝擊,西捷航空表示相關通知並不會立即影響目前的航班營運。若停工不幸發生,航空公司將採取一切必要措施管理潛在影響,包括提前通知旅客預先進行行程調整與取消。此外,西捷航空已針對預訂2026年7月30日至8月4日期間出行的旅客,提供彈性的行程變更與退票政策,受影響旅客將可依規定獲得退款或重新安排行程。 WestJet Issues 72-Hour Lockout Notice Following CUPE Strike Threat Canadian carrier WestJet issued a 72-hour lockout notice on July 30, 2026, in response to a 72-hour strike notice from the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) Local 8125. metadata.title: Diehl Aviation於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用新民航元件工廠

a-20260730-1149-diehl-aviation-opens-new.text: Diehl Aviation於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用新民航元件工廠 航空系統供應商 Diehl Aviation 在羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用全新飛機元件生產設施,拓展其歐洲製造網路。該廠廠房與辦公空間超過 12,000 平方公尺,預計於 2026 年秋季開始投產,初期規劃約 75 名員工,中期預計擴增至 500 人,將生產客艙複合材料元件、隔熱毯以及水與廢水系統箱體。 德商第一級航空系統供應商 Diehl Aviation 於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦正式啟用全新飛機元件生產設施,為該公司在歐洲的商用飛機元件製造網路增設全新營運據點。此項建廠專案係與合作夥伴 Global Vision 合作開發完成,旨在擴充其整體製造產能,並支援全球客戶的生產提升需求。 新建生產基地位於羅馬尼亞多爾日地區,佔地面積達 33,500 平方公尺,其中包含超過 12,000 平方公尺的生產與辦公空間。該設施的建設過程耗時不到一年時間, Diehl Aviation 將此專案背後的投資規模描述為中等雙位數百萬歐元金額,但未透露具體的確切金額數字。 根據營運規劃,克拉約瓦工廠預計於 2026 年秋季正式展開生產作業,初期將配置約 75 名員工。公司計劃在中期階段將團隊人力逐漸擴充至最多 500 人,且該廠房區域在最初設計時即已預留空間,以便未來如有需求時可進行進一步的擴建。 在產線配置方面,該廠將首先投入生產 Diehl Aviation 網路中既有的成熟產品,包括手動層壓客艙複合材料元件、隔熱毯以及用於飛機水與廢水系統的儲水箱。為維護一致的品質標準,公司自 2026 年 2 月起即已展開員工在航空製造、品質管理與安全規範方面的專業培訓。 在能源與基礎設施設計上,該建築與生產設備完全依靠電力運行,成功自場區能源結構中完全排除天然氣。此外,廠區目前正在安裝屋頂太陽能發電系統,以提高再生能源的使用比例。新廠啟用後,將與 Diehl Aviation 位於德國、匈牙利及墨西哥的既有據點共同構成更完整的多國製造網路。 Diehl Aviation Opens New Commercial Aircraft Component Facility in Craiova, Romania Tier-1 supplier Diehl Aviation has opened a new commercial aircraft component production facility in Craiova, Romania, expanding its manufacturing footprint in Europe. Spanning over 12,000 square meters of production and office space on a 33,500-square-meter plot, the new site represents a mid-double-digit million euro investment. Production is scheduled to begin in fall 2026 with approximately 75 employees, with plans to expand the workforce up to 500 over the medium term. The plant will produce composite cabin components, insulation blankets, and water and waste system tanks. Tier-1 aerospace supplier Diehl Aviation has officially opened a new aircraft component production facility in Craiova, Romania, adding another site to its European manufacturing network for commercial aviation components. Developed in cooperation with project partner Global Vision, the new site is designed to expand the company's overall manufacturing capacity and support customer production ramp-ups across its global network. Located in Romania's Dolj region, the facility encompasses over 12,000 square meters of production and office space built on a 33,500-square-meter plot. Constructed in less than a year, Diehl Aviation described the project's financial backing as a mid-double-digit million euro investment, without disclosing an exact figure. Production at the Craiova site is scheduled to commence in fall 2026, starting with an initial workforce of approximately 75 employees. Diehl Aviation plans to progressively scale up the facility's workforce to as many as 500 personnel over the medium term, with the site specifically designed with extra space to accommodate potential future operational expansion. The Craiova plant will manufacture products already established within Diehl Aviation's network, including manually laminated composite cabin components, insulation blankets, and tanks for aircraft water and waste systems. To maintain consistent quality standards and transfer technical know-how from existing operations, employee training in aerospace manufacturing, quality management, and safety requirements began in February 2026 ahead of the opening. In terms of sustainability and energy infrastructure, the building and its manufacturing equipment run entirely on electricity, completely eliminating natural gas from the site's energy mix. A rooftop solar system is currently being installed to further increase the share of renewable electricity used at the facility. The new Romanian site joins Diehl Aviation's active production operations in Germany, Hungary, and Mexico. metadata.title: 空中巴士公佈2026上半年財報 第二季淨利大增126%

a-20260730-1422-airbus-profits-surge-126.text: 空中巴士公佈2026上半年財報 第二季淨利大增126% 空中巴士公佈2026年第二季與上半年財務報告。受惠於第二季交機量顯著回升至237架,該季淨利同比大增126%至16.6億美元。累計上半年共交付351架民航機,合併營收達332億歐元。公司重申全年交付約870架飛機的目標,並持續推進客機產能提升計劃。 根據空中巴士與航太媒體《AeroTime》報導,空中巴士於2026年7月29日公佈了2026年上半年的合併財務業績。其中,第二季的財務數字表現尤為亮眼,受惠於民航機交付量的強勁增長,空中巴士在截至2026年6月30日的三個月內,單季淨利同比大幅增長126%,自去年同期的8.42億美元(約合7.32億歐元)增至16.6億美元(約合1.65億歐元),同時該季營收也實現了28%的增長。 在交機表現方面,空中巴士於2026年第二季(4月至6月)向客戶交付了237架民航機,相較於第一季(1月至3月)僅交付的114架大幅攀升。這使得2026年上半年的民航機交付總量達到351架(去年同期為306架),其中包括44架A220、271架A320系列、10架A330以及26架A350客機。 財務表現上,2026年上半年合併營收同比增長12%至332億歐元(約382億美元);調整後息稅前利潤(EBIT Adjusted)則達到27.27億歐元(去年同期為22.04億歐元)。空中巴士執行長 Guillaume Faury 表示,良好的上半年業績主要反映了民航機交付量的提升,以及國防與航太部門的強勁表現。 在訂單與積壓方面,空中巴士在2026年上半年共錄得886架民航機的新增總訂單(扣除取消後的淨訂單為821架),顯著高於去年同期的494架。截至2026年6月底,空中巴士的民航機未交付訂單(backlog)累積已達9,222架。 展望未來,空中巴士重申其在2026年交付約870架民航機的目標保持不變,並預計全年調整後息稅前利潤(EBIT Adjusted)將達到75億歐元(約86億美元)。同時,各客機項目的產能提升計劃仍持續推進,包括目標在2028年將A220的月產量提升至13架,在2027年底前將A320系列月產量提升至70至75架,並預期在2029年將A330月產量提升至5架、2028年將A350月產量提升至12架。 Airbus Q2 Profits Surge 126% on Strong Commercial Aircraft Deliveries Airbus reported a strong financial performance for the second quarter and first half of 2026. Driven by a surge in commercial aircraft deliveries to 237 units in Q2, the manufacturer's quarterly net income jumped 126% to $1.66 billion (€1.65 billion). For the first half of 2026, Airbus delivered 351 commercial aircraft and generated consolidated revenues of €33.2 billion. The European aerospace giant maintained its full-year guidance to deliver approximately 870 commercial aircraft and achieved a commercial order backlog of 9,222 planes by the end of June, while continuing to ramp up its passenger jet production rates across several programs. According to reports from AeroTime and official disclosures from Airbus, the European aircraft manufacturer published its consolidated financial results for the first half of 2026 on July 29, 2026. The financial data highlights a significant surge in the second quarter of the year, driven by robust commercial aircraft deliveries. Airbus' quarterly net income grew by 126% to $1.66 billion (€1.65 billion), up from $842 million (€732 million) recorded during the same period last year, while Q2 revenue increased by 28% year-on-year. In terms of operational output, Airbus delivered 237 commercial aircraft to customers between April and June 2026, marking a substantial recovery from the 114 aircraft delivered in the first quarter between January and March. This brought the total deliveries for the first half of 2026 to 351 aircraft, up from 306 deliveries in H1 2025. The H1 deliveries comprised 44 A220s, 271 A320 Family aircraft, 10 A330s, and 26 A350s. For the first six months of 2026, Airbus reported consolidated revenues of €33.2 billion ($38.2 billion), representing a 12% increase compared to €29.6 billion in H1 2025. Consolidated EBIT Adjusted, a key metric of underlying business performance, reached €2,727 million, up from €2,204 million in the prior-year period. CEO Guillaume Faury noted that the positive results primarily reflect higher commercial aircraft deliveries and strong performance within the Defense and Space division. The company also experienced strong commercial momentum, recording 886 gross commercial orders during the first half of 2026, compared to 494 gross orders in the same period last year. Net commercial orders after cancellations stood at 821 aircraft. By the end of June 2026, the manufacturer's total commercial aircraft order backlog reached 9,222 planes, highlighting sustained market demand. Looking ahead, Airbus has maintained its full-year delivery guidance of approximately 870 commercial aircraft for 2026. The company also expects its full-year EBIT Adjusted to reach €7.5 billion ($8.6 billion) by year-end. Meanwhile, Airbus continues to advance its aircraft production ramp-up targets, which include reaching a monthly production rate of 13 for the A220 in 2028, between 70 and 75 for the A320 family by the end of 2027, 5 for the A330 program in 2029, and 12 for the A350 program in 2028. metadata.title: 阿聯酋航空工程部啟動 Material Futures Studio 學生計畫

a-20260730-1631-emirates-engineering-lau.text: 阿聯酋航空工程部啟動 Material Futures Studio 學生計畫 阿聯酋航空工程部啟動為期六週的 Material Futures Studio 計畫,邀請三所大學共 23 名學生參與,將退役航空材料重新構思為新產品。該計畫由內部 Upcycling 部門主導,與既有翻新及升級回收專案相連結。 阿聯酋航空工程部啟動 Material Futures Studio,這是一項為期六週的計畫,挑戰大學生將退役航空材料重新構思並轉化為新產品。該計畫由阿聯酋航空工程部內的 Upcycling 部門主導,安排學生與航空專業人員合作,應對真實的產業挑戰。 首屆計畫共有 23 名學生參與,分別來自 Khalifa University、Emirates Aviation University 及 University of Sharjah。計畫開始時安排了導覽活動,學生參觀阿聯酋航空工程部設施,包括機隊的 A-check 與 C-check 維修作業,以及目前進行材料回收再利用的升級回收工坊。 在六週的課程中,學生將運用導覽所學,開發將航空材料升級回收並再利用為原創產品的新構想。阿聯酋航空工程部團隊成員將在構想與概念開發階段提供指導,計畫最後將舉行成果展示,由學生發表構想與原型。 Material Futures Studio 與阿聯酋航空更廣泛的翻新計畫相連結,該計畫是一項投資數十億美元、全面翻新 219 架空中巴士 A380 與波音 777 客機的專案,旨在提升機隊旅客體驗。翻新過程中拆卸的材料由阿聯酋航空工程部在杜拜以內部團隊進行升級回收,製成手工產品以減少浪費。 此學生計畫建立在阿聯酋航空既有的升級回收倡議之上,包括 Aircrafted by Emirates 限量版行李與配件系列,以及 Aircrafted KIDS 倡議。後者將翻新計畫中回收的布料與其他材料製成兒童背包,迄今已向 11 個國家的兒童捐贈超過 4,000 個背包。 Emirates Engineering launches Material Futures Studio for university students Emirates Engineering has launched Material Futures Studio, a six-week program pairing 23 students from three universities with aviation professionals to reimagine retired aircraft materials into new products. The initiative is led by the in-house Upcycling department and connects to Emirates' broader fleet retrofit effort. Emirates Engineering has launched Material Futures Studio, a six-week program challenging university students to reimagine retired aircraft materials and turn them into new products. The initiative is led by the Upcycling department within Emirates Engineering and pairs students with aviation professionals to tackle real-world industry challenges. The first edition brought together 23 students from Khalifa University, Emirates Aviation University, and the University of Sharjah. The program opened with an orientation and tour of Emirates Engineering's facilities, where students observed maintenance operations including A-checks and C-checks on the Emirates fleet, along with the upcycling shop where materials are currently being repurposed. Over the course of six weeks, students will apply what they learned during the orientation to develop new concepts for upcycling and reusing aircraft materials into original products. Members of the Emirates Engineering team will provide guidance throughout the ideation and concept development stages, and the program will conclude with a final showcase where students present their concepts and prototypes. Material Futures Studio connects to a broader retrofit program at Emirates, a multi-billion-dollar investment to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft aimed at improving the customer experience across its fleet. Materials removed from retrofitted aircraft are being repurposed through upcycling work led entirely in-house by Emirates Engineering in Dubai, with a dedicated team turning retired aircraft materials into handcrafted products meant to cut down on waste. The student program builds on other upcycling initiatives already underway at the airline, including the Aircrafted by Emirates collection of limited-edition luggage, bags, and accessories made from reclaimed aircraft interiors. It also complements the Aircrafted KIDS initiative, which has produced more than 4,000 backpacks donated to children across 11 countries. metadata.title: 阿聯酋航空工程署推出「材料未來工作室」大學生計畫

a-20260730-1732-emirates-engineering-lau.text: 阿聯酋航空工程署推出「材料未來工作室」大學生計畫 阿聯酋航空工程署於2026年7月30日啟動「材料未來工作室」六週課程,挑戰大學生重新構想退役航空材料並轉化為新產品。該計畫由「循環利用」部門領導,將學生與航空專業人士合作,解決實際的產業挑戰。 阿聯酋航空工程署於2026年7月30日推出「材料未來工作室」計畫,為大學生設計六週課程,挑戰他們重新構想退役航空材料並轉化為新產品。該計畫由阿聯酋航空工程署內的「循環利用」部門領導,將學生與航空專業人士配對,共同解決實際的產業挑戰。 首次課程共聚攜23名來自卡拉菲大學、阿聯酋航空大學及沙哈大學的學生。計畫於啟動之初舉辦導向性課程與參觀阿聯酋航空工程署設施,讓學生與高階主管會面,並 firsthand了解維修作業,包括對阿聯酋航空機隊進行的A檢與C檢,以及循環利用工廠。 學生將在六週內應用所學,發展航空材料循環利用與再利用的新概念。整個構想與概念發展階段中,他們會密切與阿聯酋航空工程署團隊成員合作,獲得指導。 計畫將於結束時舉辦最終展示,讓學生呈現他們的構想與原型,展示如何將循環利用的材料轉化為創新產品。透過結合學術研究與實務產業曝光,該計畫旨在為學生提供實際技能,並加深對航空工程生態系統的理解。 此計畫連結阿聯酋航空的廣泛改造計畫,該計畫投資數十億美元,旨在對219架空中巴士A380及波音777號機進行全面翻新,以提升客戶體驗。作為該項目的一部分,從翻新的航空器中移除的材料正被循環利用,由阿聯酋航空工程署在迪拜的專屬團隊領導,將退役航空材料轉化為手工製成的產品,以減少廢棄物。 該計畫建構在阿聯酋航空既有的其他循環利用計畫基礎上,包括「Aircrafted by Emirates」收藏系列,該系列製成限量版行李箱、袋子及配件,均使用回收的航空內飾材料。計畫亦補充了「Aircrafted KIDS」計畫,將在改造計畫中復原的布料及其他材料轉化為手工背包,目的是為兒童捐贈。迄今為止,該努力已捐贈超過4,000個背包到11個國家的兒童。 Emirates Engineering launches Material Futures Studio for university students Emirates Engineering launched a six-week Material Futures Studio program on July 30, challenging university students to reimagine retired aircraft materials and collaborate with aviation professionals to solve real-world challenges. Emirates Engineering launched the Material Futures Studio program on July 30, 2026, offering a six-week course that challenges university students to reimagine retired aircraft materials and transform them into new products. The initiative is led by the Upcycling department within Emirates Engineering, pairing students with aviation professionals to tackle real-world industry challenges. The first edition brought together 23 students from Khalifa University, Emirates Aviation University, and the University of Sharjah. The program opened with an orientation and tour of Emirates Engineering facilities, where students met with senior leaders and got a firsthand look at maintenance operations, including A-checks and C-checks performed on the Emirates fleet, along with the upcycling shop where materials are currently being repurposed. Over the course of six weeks, students apply what they learned during orientation to develop new concepts for upcycling and reusing aircraft materials into original products. Throughout the ideation and concept development stages, they work closely with members of the Emirates Engineering team for guidance. The program will wrap up with a final showcase where students present their concepts and prototypes for upcycled materials. By combining academic study with hands-on industry exposure, the initiative is designed to give students practical skills and a deeper understanding of the aviation engineering ecosystem, while giving Emirates a chance to engage with young talent and surface new ideas in the process. Material Futures Studio connects to a broader retrofit program at Emirates, a multi-billion-dollar investment to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft aimed at improving the customer experience across its fleet. As part of that project, materials removed from retrofitted aircraft are being repurposed through upcycling work led entirely in-house by Emirates Engineering in Dubai, with a dedicated team turning retired aircraft materials into handcrafted products meant to cut down on waste. The new student program builds on other upcycling initiatives already underway at the airline, including the Aircrafted by Emirates collection, a line of limited-edition luggage, bags, and accessories made from reclaimed aircraft interiors. It also complements the Aircrafted KIDS initiative, which turns fabrics and other materials recovered during the retrofit program into handmade backpacks for children. To date, that effort has resulted in more than 4,000 backpacks donated to children across 11 countries. metadata.title: 勞斯萊斯稱已有效消除AOG延誤 民航部門上半年營收成長29%

a-20260730-2107-rolls-royce-says-it-has-.text: 勞斯萊斯稱已有效消除AOG延誤 民航部門上半年營收成長29% 勞斯萊斯表示,2026年上半年大型引擎維修產出增加13%、翻修量年增35%,已有效消除民航業務的飛機停飛(AOG)延誤。民航部門營收達61.9億英鎊、營業利益成長31%,公司並上修全年獲利預測。 勞斯萊斯表示,在2026年上半年提升引擎維修與翻修工作量後,已有效消除其民航業務的飛機停飛(AOG)延誤。該公司將改善歸因於維修網路的調整及供應鏈穩定性的提升。 執行長Tufan Erginbilgic表示:「我們也已有效消除飛機停飛,為客戶提供顯著的營運效益。」AOG情況發生於航空公司因等待引擎、替換零件或維修工作而無法營運飛機時。 勞斯萊斯指出,截至2026年6月30日止六個月內,大型引擎維修產出增加13%,大型引擎翻修數量較上年同期成長35%。民航部門完成712次長期服務協議廠級維修,較上年的696次增加2%;主要大型引擎廠級維修則自217次增至294次。 該公司交付279具新民航引擎,成長18%,其中包括157具大型引擎及122具公務與區域航空引擎。在引擎耐久性方面,近半數Trent 1000 TEN機隊已升級高壓渦輪葉片至Trent 1000 XE標準,幾乎整個Trent 7000機隊亦已完成相同升級。 民航部門上半年營收成長29%至61.9億英鎊,營業利益增加31%至15.7億英鎊,營業利益率達25.3%。大型引擎飛行時數成長4%,達到2019年上半年水準的113%。 勞斯萊斯在上半年的業績表現後上修全年預測,目前預期基本營業利益介於47億至49億英鎊之間,高於先前預測的40億至42億英鎊。 Rolls-Royce Says It Has Effectively Eliminated AOG Delays; Civil Aerospace Revenue Rises 29% Rolls-Royce reported a 13% increase in large-engine maintenance output and a 35% rise in refurbishments during the first half of 2026, saying it has effectively eliminated aircraft-on-ground delays. Civil Aerospace revenue reached £6.19 billion and the company raised its full-year profit forecast. Rolls-Royce said it has effectively eliminated aircraft-on-ground (AOG) delays in its civil aerospace business after increasing engine maintenance and refurbishment work during the first half of 2026. The company linked the improvement to changes across its maintenance network and greater stability in its supply chain. CEO Tufan Erginbilgic stated: "We have also effectively eliminated aircraft on ground, providing a significant operational benefit to our customers." An AOG case occurs when an airline cannot operate an aircraft because it is waiting for an engine, replacement part or maintenance work. Rolls-Royce increased large-engine maintenance output by 13% during the six months ending June 30, 2026, while the number of large-engine refurbishments rose 35% from a year earlier. The Civil Aerospace unit completed 712 long-term service agreement shop visits, up 2% from 696, and major large-engine shop visits increased to 294 from 217. The company delivered 279 new civil engines, up 18%, including 157 large engines and 122 engines for business and regional aircraft. On durability, nearly half of the Trent 1000 TEN fleet has received upgraded high-pressure turbine blades bringing those engines to the Trent 1000 XE standard, and nearly the entire Trent 7000 fleet has received the same upgrade. Civil Aerospace revenue rose 29% to £6.19 billion during the first half, with operating profit increasing 31% to £1.57 billion and the operating margin reaching 25.3%. Large-engine flying hours increased 4%, reaching 113% of the level recorded in the first half of 2019. Rolls-Royce raised its full-year forecast following the first-half results, now expecting underlying operating profit of between £4.7 billion and £4.9 billion, up from its previous forecast of £4 billion to £4.2 billion. a-20260730-2213-faa-releases-transition-.text: FAA發布通用航空活塞機隊轉用無鉛航空汽油過渡計畫 美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)於2026年7月30日發布無鉛航空汽油過渡計畫,以分階段方式將無鉛燃料安全導入通用航空機隊,履行2024年FAA再授權法要求於2030年前完成活塞引擎機隊轉型的國會授權。FAA目前正於William J Hughes技術中心測試三種燃料,並透過EAGLE倡議與產業合作推進。 美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)於2026年7月30日發布「無鉛航空汽油過渡計畫」,提供將無鉛燃料安全導入通用航空機隊的路線圖。該計畫採分階段方式,涵蓋燃料測試與授權、蒐集市場經驗、執行全國過渡,以及管理阿拉斯加的特殊過渡安排。 FAA署長Bryan Bedford表示,轉用無鉛燃料對通用航空社群及機場周邊居民均為正面進展,並強調此為涵蓋飛機製造商、燃料供應商、機場與飛行員的協同努力。 該計畫履行2024年FAA再授權法的一項條款,該條款要求FAA與航空產業合作,透過EAGLE(消除航空汽油鉛排放)倡議,於2030年前將活塞引擎機隊安全轉型為無鉛航空汽油。作為過渡第一階段的一環,FAA正於William J Hughes技術中心測試三種不同燃料,以釐清性能與相容性等關鍵問題,並將於第一階段完成後更新計畫。 FAA於2026年1月公布過渡計畫草案並徵詢公眾意見,機構運用這些意見改善並釐清最終計畫。FAA將於2026年稍晚發布的補充文件中摘要說明相關意見。 FAA與EAGLE利害關係人合作推動多項倡議,包括執行FAA活塞航空燃料倡議(PAFI)以支援LyondellBasell/VP Racing的UL100與Swift Fuels的100R的機隊授權;透過補充型別合格證(STC)途徑加速批准GAMI的G100UL與Swift Fuels的100R;並鼓勵機場引進無鉛燃料替代品的同時,要求在過渡期間維持100LL的供應。為防止推動過程中出現供應中斷,FAA將執行聯邦補助保證義務,確保機場在安全且廣泛可及的無鉛替代品到位前持續供應含鉛100LL。 FAA Releases Transition Plan for General Aviation Piston Fleet to Unleaded Aviation Gas On July 30, 2026, the FAA released its Transition Plan for Unleaded Aviation Gasoline, providing a phased roadmap to safely integrate unleaded fuel into the general aviation fleet. The plan fulfills a provision of the 2024 FAA Reauthorization Act requiring the agency to partner with industry through the EAGLE initiative to transition the piston-engine fleet to unleaded avgas by 2030. The FAA is testing three fuels at the William J Hughes Technical Center. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) released its Transition Plan for Unleaded Aviation Gasoline on July 30, 2026, providing a roadmap to safely integrate unleaded fuel into the general aviation fleet. The plan uses a phased approach to address fuel testing and authorization, gather market experience, execute the national transition, and manage the unique transition in Alaska. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the transition to unleaded fuel is a positive step forward for the general aviation community and people who live and work near general aviation airports, describing it as a collaborative effort involving aircraft manufacturers, fuel suppliers, airports, and pilots. The plan fulfills a provision of the 2024 FAA Reauthorization Act requiring the agency to partner with the aviation industry to safely transition the piston-engine fleet to unleaded aviation gas by 2030. This partnership was carried out through the Eliminate Aviation Gasoline Lead Emissions (EAGLE) initiative. As part of the first phase, the FAA is testing three different fuels at the William J Hughes Technical Center to address key questions concerning performance and compatibility, and will update the plan after the first phase is complete. In January 2026, the FAA published a draft of the transition plan and invited public comments. The agency used these comments to improve and clarify the final plan. The FAA will summarize the comments in a supplemental document that will publish in late 2026. To prevent premature supply disruptions, the FAA is enforcing Federal Grant Assurance obligations to ensure airports continue to offer leaded 100LL until safe, fleet-wide unleaded alternatives are widely and locally accessible. a-20260731-0429-comac-s-high-altitude-c9.text: 中國商飛C919高原型客機在上海成功完成首飛 中國商用飛機有限責任公司(COMAC)研製的C919高原型客機(C919-600)於2026年7月29日在上海浦東國際機場成功完成首飛,首飛歷時1小時59分鐘。該機型由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發,機身較標準版縮短約6個隔框,規劃載客量為140至160人,專為高高原機場營運設計。 中國商用飛機有限責任公司(COMAC)研製的C919高原型客機於2026年7月29日成功完成首次試飛。該架註冊號為B-002U、型號為C919-600的試飛樣機,於上海浦東國際機場起飛,在完成全部預定試飛科目後安全降落,整個飛行過程歷時1小時59分鐘。 該款高原型客機由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發,其機身設計較C919標準版縮短了約6個隔框,規劃載客量為140至160人。根據中國民航相關規定,海拔在2,438公尺(8,000英呎)或以上的機場即歸類為高高原機場,該機型正是為滿足此類高海拔區域的營運需求而進行了專門的系統功能優化與機身修改。 COMAC's High-Altitude C919 Variant Completes Maiden Flight China's COMAC has completed the maiden test flight of its new C919 high-altitude (plateau) variant in Shanghai. On July 29, 2026, the prototype, registered as B-002U (C919-600), took off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport and performed all scheduled maneuvers during a flight lasting one hour and 59 minutes. Jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines, this high-altitude variant features a shortened fuselage that is approximately six frames shorter than the standard version. It is designed to accommodate between 140 and 160 passengers and operates in high-altitude regions, which Chinese regulations define as airports at elevations of 2,438 meters or higher. a-20260731-0429-israeli-air-force-reacti.text: 以色列空軍重新啟用第193中隊 換裝新型海鷹直升機 以色列空軍於2026年7月28日在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地舉行儀式,正式重新啟用第193中隊。該中隊曾於2025年8月因舊型AS565豹式直升機退役而關閉,此次重啟換裝了新型西科斯基SH-60F海鷹海上直升機,目前已有三架運抵以色列,年底前預計再接收兩架。 以色列空軍於2026年7月28日在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地舉行儀式,正式重新啟用第193中隊。該中隊將負責操作新型的西科斯基SH-60F海鷹海上直升機(希伯來語稱為「Shalach」),以執行支援海軍及擴大海上作戰應對等任務。 第193中隊原於1987年成立,曾操作「Atalef」AS565豹式直升機,並在該機型於2025年8月退役後關閉。目前已有三架海鷹直升機運抵以色列,年底前預計將再交付兩架。其中兩架正於國防公司進行作戰整合。 Israeli Air Force Reactivates Squadron 193 with New Seahawk Helicopters The Israeli Air Force has reactivated Squadron 193 at Palmachim Airbase on July 28, 2026, following the arrival of new Sikorsky SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters, known in Hebrew as Shalach. The squadron had been shut down in August 2025 after the retirement of its AS565 Panther helicopters, leaving the Navy without a dedicated maritime helicopter. Three Seahawks have arrived in Israel so far, with two more expected by the end of the year. Currently, two of the arrived helicopters are undergoing operational integration at Israeli defense companies. The Israeli Air Force reactivated Squadron 193 during a ceremony held at Palmachim Airbase on July 28, 2026. The squadron will operate the new Sikorsky SH-60F Seahawk maritime helicopters, designated "Shalach" in Hebrew, to support the Israeli Navy and expand maritime operational capabilities. Squadron 193 had been closed in August 2025 following the retirement of its AS565 Panther ("Atalef") helicopters. Three Seahawk helicopters have arrived in Israel so far, with two more expected by the end of the year. Two of the current aircraft are undergoing operational integration at local defense companies before flight testing and entry into service. 以色列空軍於2026年7月28日在帕爾馬希姆空軍基地舉行儀式,重新啟用第193中隊。 A ceremony marking the squadron’s reactivation was held at Palmachim Airbase on July 28, 2026. 第193中隊代表以色列海軍操作海上直升機,此次重啟是因應新型西科斯基SH-60F海鷹直升機的抵達。 The Israeli Air Force has reopened Squadron 193, which operates maritime helicopters on behalf of the Israeli Navy, following the arrival of new Sikorsky SH-60F Seahawk helicopters. 目前已有三架希伯來語稱為「Shalach」的海鷹直升機運抵以色列,年底前預計將再接收兩架。 Three Seahawks, designated “Shalach” in Hebrew, have arrived in Israel so far, with two more expected by the end of the year. 該中隊先前在AS565豹式直升機(以色列稱為「Atalef」)退役後,於2025年8月關閉。 The squadron had been shut down in August 2025 after the retirement of its AS565 Panther helicopters, known in Israeli service as “Atalef.”
